model.name: Task 37.5: Dual-status reconcile — one truth (status vs statusChecklist), no Done-ness flip [R37.5]
model.description: R37.5 (architect-surfaced during R37.2 design). A Task unit carries TWO independent status fields — model.status (-> planning checkbox) AND model.statusChecklist (free-text -> task-md '## Status') — which can DISAGREE WITHIN the source (e.g. Task 95: status='In Progress' but statusChecklist all-checked). R37.5 makes a task's status ONE truth WITHOUT flipping its displayed Done-ness (disagreements are surfaced for the honesty audit, never silently reconciled to Done = a status invention). Kept OUT of R37.2 (which regenerates from BOTH fields as-is, INV-C4).
